  <svg
    height="1em"

      flex: "none",
      lineHeight: 1,
    }}
    viewBox="0 0 24 24"
    width="1em"
    xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"

      <linearGradient
        id="lobe-icons-gemini-fill"
        x1="0%"
        x2="68.73%"
        y1="100%"

        <stop offset="0%" stopColor="#1C7DFF" />
        <stop offset="52.021%" stopColor="#1C69FF" />
        <stop offset="100%" stopColor="#F0DCD6" />

      fillRule="nonzero"

);
export default Gemini;
